images.prompt: A young brahmin boy, barely of playing age, sits cross-legged in a forest clearing surrounded by ancient trees, his face calm and innocent yet holding a small blade of grass (darba) in his tiny hands, pointing it symbolically toward a noble king Parikshit who stands before him in royal attire with folded hands, as other sages and students watch silently from the surrounding forest shadows
images.caption:
📖 Srimad Bhagavatam — Canto 10, Chapter 166
श्रुत्वा तच्चरितं प्राह परीक्षिद् राज्ञा सुनिश्चितम्
Hearing that story, King Parikshit inquired with certainty
In this poignant scene, a young brahmin boy, barely of playing age, sits calmly in a forest clearing, holding a small blade of grass. Before him stands King Parikshit, in royal attire with folded hands. The boy, an instrument of divine will, curses the king. This event unfolds as part of a larger divine play. The king, having been cursed, accepts his fate. The spiritual significance lies in the detachment and acceptance shown by both the boy and the king. May we learn from their example. May we too accept life's challenges with equanimity. 🙏 Hare Krishna

images.prompt: King Parikshit, dressed in royal garments, stands peacefully in a forest hermitage with hands joined in reverence, his expression serene and undisturbed despite receiving the curse, while a brahmin sage-rishi nearby sits in deep meditation under a tall tree, both figures calm and unaffected by the dramatic event around them, sunlight filtering through the dense forest canopy above
images.caption:
📖 Srimad Bhagavatam — Canto 10, Chapter 166
श्रीपरीक्षिदुवाच संस्थितोऽहं भगवन्प्रतीक्षये तव
Shri Parikshit said, I am waiting for you, O Lord
King Parikshit, a devotee, stands serene in a forest hermitage, despite receiving a curse. A brahmin sage sits in meditation nearby. The curse was a result of Parikshit's accidental offense. The sage's calm demeanor reflects his detachment. Parikshit's devotion keeps him peaceful. This scene shows the power of faith and detachment.
May we learn from their examples. 🙏 Hare Krishna

images.prompt: Shukadeva Goswami appears at the edge of a forest path, a young radiant sage with matted hair and glowing presence, walking toward a gathering of sages and disciples seated on the riverbank under open sky, Suta Goswami standing respectfully among the assembly gesturing toward the approaching Shukadeva, whose arrival fills the scene with divine anticipation and spiritual light
images.caption:
📖 Srimad Bhagavatam — Canto 10, Chapter 166
श्री शुकदेव गोस्वामी प्रकट होते हैं
Shri Shukadeva Goswami appears
As the assembly of sages and disciples gathers on the riverbank, Suta Goswami gestures toward the approaching Shukadeva Goswami. The young sage's radiant presence fills the scene with divine anticipation. Shukadeva's arrival marks the beginning of a divine tale that will guide Maharaj Parikshit toward moksha. The sages and disciples eagerly await his words. This moment is a turning point in the narrative. As we reflect on this scene, may we too seek guidance from the wise. 🙏 Hare Krishna
